elements.text: Every control on these pages is one of the game's own widgets, lifted from the screen that owns it and built on a screen of RIX's own.
Pick a widget on the left. Each page says which game screen it comes from.
Page variables so far: choice = {var:demo.choice}, toggle = {var:demo.toggle}, volume = {var:demo.volume}, code = {var:demo.code}

items.label: Menu buttons
items.description: RIX::MenuKit::menu - the button list of the Battle Pack, Help & Options and Pause screens.

items.label: Volume bar
items.description: ScreenHelpSetting::tickLine_t - the 10-tick bar from Help & Options > Settings.

items.label: Digit wheels
items.description: widget_EntryDigit - the code entry from the Player Match (Live) setting screen.

items.label: Card details
items.description: widget_CardDetails - the deck editor's card picture and text panel.

items.label: Free Duel pickers
items.description: widget_pickSeries and widget_pickCharacter - the series row and opponent grid of Free Duel.

items.label: Deck picker
items.description: widget_RecipeZone and widget_RecipeInfo - the Free Duel deck grid and deck panel.

items.label: Message boxes
items.description: widget_Dialog - the OK and Yes / No boxes every screen owns.
